description.value:
At-will enemies in range take a −1 status penalty to Will saves

7th — Off-Book once per round, an enemy in range that fails a save against your spell is also off-guard until the end of its next turn. 15th — The Gap spend 3 Encore to force one creature in range to attempt a Will save against your spell DC; on a failure it treats its next check as its lowest possible result.
